# Greenback Expat Tax Services

> Greenback Expat Tax Services is a specialized tax preparation firm dedicated to helping US expats, digital nomads, and retirees navigate complex international tax compliance requirements.

Greenback provides comprehensive expat tax services including federal and state tax return preparation, FBAR and FATCA reporting, streamlined filing procedures, and personalized tax consultations. The firm serves Americans living abroad across multiple countries and specializes in catch-up compliance for those with filing arrears.

## Key Topics

- Expat Tax Services
- FBAR Filing
- FATCA Reporting

- US Tax Compliance
- IRS Enrolled Agents

## Core Services

- [Greenback Expat Tax Services & Pricing](https://www.greenbacktaxservices.com/services): Main services overview: tax planning, return prep, FBAR, FATCA reporting
- [Federal US Tax Return Preparation for Americans Living Abroad](https://www.greenbacktaxservices.com/services/federal-us-tax-return-preparation): Federal tax return preparation for expats and recently repatriated Americans
- [Foreign Bank Account Reporting (FBAR) Services & Pricing](https://www.greenbacktaxservices.com/services/filing-fbar-with-us-expat-taxes): FBAR filing services for Americans with $10,000+ in foreign accounts
- [Form 8938 Preparation for Americans Living Abroad](https://www.greenbacktaxservices.com/services/fatca-form-8938): FATCA Form 8938 preparation for foreign asset reporting compliance
- [Streamlined Filing Package & Services - Greenback Expat Taxes](https://www.greenbacktaxservices.com/services/late-taxes-streamlined-filing-procedures): Streamlined Filing Procedures for catch-up tax compliance assistance
- [Tax Consultations for U.S. Expats - Greenback Tax Services](https://www.greenbacktaxservices.com/services/expat-tax-consultation): Personalized tax consultation services from CPAs and IRS Enrolled Agents
